newsitem.title: USA: VITAL IMAGES COMPLETES DUKE UNIV SOFTWARE PACT.
newsitem.headline: VITAL IMAGES COMPLETES DUKE UNIV SOFTWARE PACT.

text.p: Vital Images Inc said Tuesday it has completed a software licensing agreement with Duke University for Duke's DICOM 3.0-conformant network software libraries.

The pact gives it the right to Duke's object and source code, to incorporate the software into its current and future medical visualization products, and to make enhancements and upgrades, the company said in a news release.
Specific terms of the agreement were not disclosed.

The software gives Vital Images' Vitrea workstation the ability to query and retrieve data or accept data from DICOM compliant scanners and image archives on a hospital network. The software also lets Vitrea send reports to a DICOM- compatible printer. It said these features have been used in Duke University medical centers' radiology department.
Vitrea is Vital Images' three-dimensional disagnostic workstations that let uers interactively visualize radiological images in two and three dimensions.
Vital Images Inc develops two- and three-dimensional visualization software and workstations for medical research, clinical diagnosis, surgial planning and naviogation.
Its shares traded Tuesday at 1-3/4, down 1/16.
